The '''Draenell Planetary Council''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. Around [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], the Draenell Planetary Council ceded control of the planet to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to prevent an invasion.
